list: the official 55 trophies, cross-checked 2026-11-20 against PushSquare, Gamemapa, KeenGamer, EGamers, HowToVideoGame, Mobalytics and Games.gg — all agree on every name, description and grade; 28 hidden, 0 online
note: Guides are original writing for this entry. Where the unlock method was still unconfirmed on 2026-11-20 the guide says so instead of inventing steps. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off on a trophy run.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Expect roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough, with the story taking 60 to 80 of them and the 100% completion cleanup taking about 100 more. The last trophy most players earn is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, so plan the whole run around that checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is the first mission of the game. Just play the story from the start and it pops at the mission's end. No side work is needed for it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when the final mission of Chapter 1 ends. Play through the chapter in order and it pops on its own. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one-time balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends, because that moment does not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the last mission of Chapter 2. There is nothing extra to prepare; keep playing the story missions in order. Billy's side missions open during this chapter, so pick those up as they appear if you want them done early.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when Chapter 3 ends. Andy's and Randy's side missions and Tyrone's strand all open in this chapter, so work on them while you are playing through it rather than leaving them all for after the story. The chapter itself needs no special preparation.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when Chapter 4 ends. Three of the named story-mission trophies (Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked) are earned inside this chapter, so they will pop along the way. Keep a separate manual save at the start of the chapter, since the game has no mission replay and 15 manual save slots.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the final story mission, which sits in Chapter 5. Finishing it also opens the 100% completion checklist under Progress, and the whole of Leonida stays open for free roam afterwards, so nothing in the cleanup is locked behind the ending. Do not turn cheats on for this run: they only unlock after the story and they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Just follow the mission markers when it appears in the story flow. It cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Play the mission when the story offers it and the trophy pops at its end. Heist preparation is part of the mission itself, so no outside setup is required.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It comes up naturally in the chapter's mission order, so keep playing the story and it will pop. No collectible or side requirement feeds into it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Follow the story missions in order and it pops at the end of the mission. It is one of three named-mission trophies inside Chapter 4, alongside Family Matters and Hi-Jacked.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, set around Vice City International Airport. Play it when the story offers it and the trophy pops on completion. The airport itself matters again later for Catch Me If You Can, which asks you to steal an airliner from VCIA in free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it unlocks when you finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies, so by the time it pops you are near the end of the story. Keep playing the main missions in order and it will come to you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for reaching 100% completion, and the hardest trophy on the list. The checklist only appears under Progress after you finish the story, and it does not ask for literally everything: for example it wants 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges, but it does want every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range and every drone race. Work through the checklist in the order this guide's roadmap gives, and check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion often so you can see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida: stunt jumps off ramps and bridges, flying under bridges, knife flights between tall buildings in Vice City, and base jumps off peaks and tall buildings. You only need a little over half of them, so skip the ones that frustrate you and move on. Track them under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or finish well at any of them, just take part once in each. This is an easy early trophy: sample one of each as you pass them during the story and it pops once the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting ranges. This is one of the hardest trophies after A Long Road, so treat it as a practice grind rather than a one-visit task: learn each challenge's target pattern, replay the ones you miss, and use the range's own scoring feedback to tighten your time. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so none of this work is wasted.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need 14 wins in total, one per spot. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race to win; winning every location is also part of the 100% completion checklist, so it pays off twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Replaying the same race does not count twice, so work through the race list and tick off a new one each time. Pick the vehicle class you are most comfortable with, and save the harder race types for after you have a fast, well-handling car.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His questline starts in Chapter 1, so meet him early and follow his fishing missions until a head-to-head challenge is offered. You need a boat and a fishing rod for it; boats are easy to take from the water around Leonida if you do not own one yet. Win the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four arcade video games. Three of them are playable on the TV at home, so this is one of the cheapest trophies in the game: sit down, pick a game and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score, just a completed run.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Andy's quests, which are Lucia-only and open from Chapter 3, then complete his final mission. Work through his strand as the missions appear rather than leaving them to the end. The trophy pops when the last mission in his strand is done.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all seven shipwrecks for Kenton, whose strand opens in Chapter 1, and finish his final mission. The wrecks are underwater, so take a boat out to each marked site and dive them one by one. Kenton can go quiet for a while mid-strand, according to community reports, but he is still available in free roam after the story, so the trophy is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Billy's quests at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, which open from Chapter 2, then complete his final mission. The strand is built around mud-club driving, so bring a vehicle that handles off-road well. The trophy pops at the end of his last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show as purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters, so sweep the map for them as you play and finish each strand to its end rather than starting many and finishing none. This is a post-story cleanup job for most players: the checklist does not ask for these quests, so they are often what is left after 100%.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's wish list, starting from Chapter 3, and then complete his final mission. Each car has to be found, driven to the drop-off and handed over, so treat it as a long scavenger list you chip away at while doing other things. The trophy pops when the last delivery and the final mission are done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs for Tyrone and finish his last quest. His strand is Jason-only and opens from Chapter 3. Work through his missions as they appear, and be ready for a fight at the lab sites, since they are guarded. The trophy pops at the end of his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations. This is the one trophy that may be missable, so do it carefully: early in Chapter 1, after one of the first missions, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt and meditate with her there, because that moment cannot be repeated after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it. After that, visit every marked meditation spot and meditate at each; the Progress menu tracks your count.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, in a Jason-only strand. Study animals through your binoculars while you play, since the 100% checklist wants 100 of the 255 animals studied anyway, and follow Bret's missions until the unique hunt is offered. Unconfirmed at time of writing: guides disagree on exactly which animal the hunt targets, so follow Bret's in-game markers rather than any single community guess.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found across Leonida. Cards are tucked into the world rather than sold, so pick them up as you explore and keep a note of which sets are nearly complete, then hunt the last cards of three sets. You only need 3 sets for this trophy, but 15 sets count toward 100% completion, so keep collecting after it pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida. Open WAiNK at anything interesting, scan it, and move on; the count climbs fast if you scan as you travel instead of saving it all for the end. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges. The challenges cover almost everything in the game, from driving to combat to exploration, so many will complete themselves as you play. You can skip the 30 nastiest ones, since only 50 are needed, and 70 count toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the police and escape the heat zone. Robbing a bank vault gives you a 4-star level instantly, so that is a reliable way to set it up. Community reports suggest the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is one of the easiest escapes, since officers struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a short route through three shops close together: community reports point to the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City as a good run. Keep moving, do not let the wanted level drop to zero mid-run, and note that the trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app, so scan every new vehicle you pass and drive anything unusual you find. It should come naturally during the story, and you can track the count under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, and carry Adrenaline so you can extend it. Community reports say it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a fight with gang members at one of their illegal operations, use an assault rifle, and chain the five takedowns inside the one focus window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and fly it at least 1 km away from the airport. Community reports point to the airliners at terminals E3 and E4 as the easiest to reach. Expect heavy police attention on the ground, so get aboard fast, take off quickly, and keep flying until you are a kilometre clear.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, according to community reports. The base is guarded, so plan a fast approach, grab the tank and drive it out before the response builds up. The trophy's own description is a joke about the heat inside a Rhino, but the task is simply to take one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun for this, which becomes available from Chapter 3, so do not attempt it before then. Move quietly, take what you need and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you can try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults in the game and escape after each one. Plan each robbery like a small heist: pick your target, get in and out fast, and lose the police before the next. Escaping after the robbery is part of the requirement, so do not count a vault until you are clear. All five also count toward the 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear of the police. A quiet stretch of road away from heavy traffic makes the escape much easier than trying it in the middle of Vice City.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the fog is cleared from the entire map. Drive, fly and sail through every region so the map fills in, including the smaller towns and rural counties that the story never sends you to. It is a natural companion to the collectible and WAiNK hunts, so work on it alongside them rather than as a separate chore.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs in Leonida; there are 39 such operations in total, so you can pick the easiest one per gang. Each robbery is a small fight-and-grab, so go in armed and ready, take the takings and leave. The trophy pops once all nine gangs have been hit at least once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at time of writing: the official description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide had pinned down the exact trigger by 20 November 2026, and PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The sensible first try is to visit a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it to a spot with a view of the water. Do not trust any single community guess until players confirm a repeatable trigger.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at time of writing: the description asks you to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, but no guide had confirmed the exact showroom or trigger by 20 November 2026, and PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The likely shape is driving a car through a showroom's glass frontage, in the style of the classic GTA showroom smash, but treat that as a guess, not a verified method, until players confirm it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Community reports say the trophy is tied to taking all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and then losing the police, rather than simply playing a game of bowling. Treat that as the current best lead, not a confirmed method: visit the alley, look for the valuables, and leave clean.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Community reports say this trophy is about maxing out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Keep both of them training until both Strength stats are maxed, and the trophy should pop then. This method is reported rather than officially confirmed, so if it does not pop, keep training and check the in-game stats screen.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost anything with a consequence counts, from crimes to choices in missions, so the count climbs steadily through normal play. There is no single thing to grind: just keep playing, making choices and taking actions, and check your Criminal Profile progress under Progress to see the count move.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at time of writing: the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide had confirmed the exact trigger by 20 November 2026, and PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. It may be tied to failing and then retrying a specific activity, but that is a guess from the wording alone. Do not chase it specifically until players confirm a repeatable method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at time of writing: the description suggests witnessing something strange, but no guide had confirmed the exact event or place by 20 November 2026, and PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. It is most likely tied to one of the game's odd open-world encounters, so explore widely and it may pop on its own. Treat any specific location claimed online as unverified until players can repeat it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at time of writing: the description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls someone over, but no guide had confirmed the exact move or target by 20 November 2026, and PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The wording points to striking a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, most likely near a bowling alley, but that is a reading of the description, not a verified method. Try it in free roam once other trophies are done.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies, so run bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies, then take the marked cash to a fence to clean it. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering everything you earn and the trophy pops at $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops in the game. Any shop spending counts, from clothes and weapons to food and vehicles, so buy what you actually need as you play and the total will grow on its own. If you are close near the end, top it up with a big purchase such as a vehicle or a garage. The total is cumulative, so it never resets.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties, which cost about $160,000 in total. Use the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone to find and buy them: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600) and Wyatt Motors ($21,600) are five of them, with three more to find on the app. Each garage has one parking spot and lets you store a registered vehicle, which you can then call with Scooter Bros.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. First store a vehicle in one of your garages, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app, or register it at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop; registered vehicles can then be called with Scooter Bros. Do this for ten different vehicles and the trophy pops. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes, so buy the garages first.
